blocks.text:
This was [Child Name]'s favorite park
in all of Grass Valley.
[Child Name] ran in, ready to play.

Swings. Tunnels. Sand.
A climbing wall like a mountain.
The slide looked even longer from here.

[Child Name] did not know 
what to do.

blocks.text:
That night, [Child Name] 
sat quietly on the bed.
The big feeling was still there.
"That was scary," said a tiny voice.
A light blinked  beside the bed.

The lights made a path
across the floor.

"Let's look together,"
said the tiny voice.
"This way," said the voice. "Whenever you're ready."
On the quiet path  lay a clue:

blocks.text: In a warm, magical clearing, Owl appeared.

"I am your quiet voice," said Owl, "in a shape 
you can see."
The warm quiet was inside [Child Name], too.
The magical forest grew small below.

Ahead was the park, the ladder, and the 
very, very tall slide.
Owl stayed close. So did the quiet voice.
